toolsPreview.name: scan_url
toolsPreview.description: Scan a live URL for leaked API keys, exposed config files and missing security headers. Returns a Launch Readiness score (0-100) and a paste-ready fix for each finding. Use before deploying, or when checking the security of an app built with AI coding tools like Cursor, Lovable, v0 or Bolt.
